description: This file contains the implementation of the UpdateGroupCommandHandler class, which handles commands to update group entities within the software. It integrates with the grouping service to perform the update operation.

classes.name: UpdateGroupCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service component that handles 'UPDATE' commands for 'GROUP' entities, delegating the update operation to the GroupingTypesWritePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JSON command to update a group, delegating the update operation to the GroupingTypesWritePlatformService.
